review.notes: Checked the authored document roles, permission exceptions and positive/negative resolution against the cited IRCC sources. See docs/content-review-2026-10-26.md. This is an agent source review, not independent human or immigration-authority approval.

assumptions: Adult on a direct commercial SFO–YVR flight for a short visit. Identity, genuine documents, booking, U.S. departure and unrelated airline checks are stipulated satisfied. Inspect the document types, dates and Canadian travel permission yourself.

Only documents initially shown or obtainable through the offered questions are available. There is no unmentioned additional citizenship, Canadian permanent residence, or other Canadian travel exemption. U.S. status and any claimed diplomatic accreditation can be clarified through the offered questions.
Names and document numbers are synthetic. Carrier lookups are simulated. Airline acceptance does not guarantee admission at the Canadian border.

Air Beluga training procedure (fictional carrier policy): complete the offered checks. If a material identity, status or permission conflict still cannot be resolved at this desk, escalate to a supervisor rather than assume approval or a definitive refusal. Unfamiliar document types alone are not a reason to escalate.
clues: I have lived in the United States for years. These are the cards I brought today.

questions.label: Ask for an extension notice or other current status proof
questions.response: I have an I-797 notice with my expired card, but the part identifying the petition and extension period is unreadable. I have no other status proof.

questions.label: Verify the notice type and extension period
questions.response: Simulated check: the notice cannot be matched to a qualifying petition or a current extension period at this desk. A supervisor must resolve it; the result neither confirms nor disproves LPR status.

questions.response: I do not have a Canadian visitor visa.

rationale: The card expired before travel, but some expired cards with qualifying I-797 notices are accepted proof. The notice type and extension period remain unresolved after the offered verification, and no Canadian visa supplies an alternative path. Escalate under the fictional Air Beluga desk procedure. This is not a conclusion that LPR status has ended or that every expired card must be denied.
